description: Defines ASN.1 structures, enums, and classes related to 3GPP NR RRC radio bearer configuration, including enumerations for ciphering algorithms, data split thresholds, timers, and complex sequence structures for radio bearer setup.

classes.name: ul_data_split_thres_opts
classes.description: Enumeration options for uplink data split thresholds.

classes.name: discard_timer_ext_r16_opts
classes.description: Enumeration options for extended timers in R16.

classes.name: ethernet_hdr_compress_r16_s
classes.description: Sequence structure for Ethernet header compression in R16.

classes.name: ul_data_compress_r17_c
classes.description: Choice structure for uplink data compression in R17.

classes.name: discard_timer_ext2_r17_opts
classes.description: Enumeration options for extended timers in R17.

classes.name: discard_timer_for_low_importance_r18_opts
classes.description: Enumeration options for low importance discard timers in R18.

classes.name: security_cfg_s
classes.description: Structure for overall security configuration including key management.

classes.name: tmgi_r17_s
classes.description: Structure representing TMGI (Temporary Mobile Group Identity) in R17.

classes.name: mrb_to_add_mod_r17_s
classes.description: Structure for adding/modifying radio bearers in R17.

classes.name: radio_bearer_cfg_s
classes.description: Main structure for radio bearer configuration including multiple substructures.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Converts enum options to string representation.

methods.name: to_number
methods.description: Converts enum options to numeric value.

methods.name: destroy_
methods.description: Cleans up dynamically allocated resources in choice structures.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the value of a choice enum.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the current selected type in a choice structure.

methods.name: set_not_used
methods.description: Marks the choice as not used.

methods.name: set_rohc
methods.description: Sets the choice to ROHC header compression.

methods.name: set_ul_only_rohc
methods.description: Sets the choice to UL only ROHC header compression.

methods.name: set_new_setup
methods.description: Configures the structure for a new setup.

methods.name: set_drb_continue_udc
methods.description: Configures the structure for DRB continue UDC.
